chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Shamoun, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Misma', from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Not one of you should touch the clothes of the one who has not worn them yet'.

key_terms.لَمْ يَكْسَهُ: has not worn it (condition of being worn)

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for a garment to be valid for wiping during ablution?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through the chain of the prominent scholar Mismar, clarifies the condition of 'wearing' (libas) required for the validity of wiping over garments (khuff) during ablution. It establishes that the garment must have been previously worn to acquire the status of a valid covering, thereby excluding new or unworn items from ritual purification practices. This ruling is foundational in Shia fiqh for distinguishing between mere possession and actual usage in the context of minor ritual purity.
